text:
use "aghousehold.dta",clear 

keep if year==2001

gen yield=hx95_nh125/hx95_nh112
gen fertilizer=nh6_3/hx95_nh112

*** 1 ****
gen migration=(h95_nh269>0)
gen log_yield=log(1+yield)
gen log_fertilizer=log(1+fertilizer)

*** 2 ****
reg migration log_yield 

*** 4 ****
merge m:1 vl_id using "village_rainfall.dta"
keep if _merge==3
gen log_av_rain=log(av_rain)

reg log_yield log_av_rain
predict hat_log_yield if log_yield!=. ,xb //caution please!

*** 5 ****
reg migration hat_log_yield

*** 6 ****
ivregress 2sls migration (log_yield=log_av_rain)
